items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: John Skenk was interested in me putting a band together... John Skenk was there and said, we got togetherness, and we wanted to book me and manage me. And we set that up.

ctx.x: John Skenk, with the money. John Skenk was interested in me putting a band together. And we had met at -- Chippy Hill left us and went to New York. And within weeks, she was dead, and they brought her back to New York, and I was the only white person at the funeral.
